newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Appeals Court favors Frontier in suit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Appeals Court favors Frontier in suit.

text.p: Frontier Adjusters of America Inc Tuesday said the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit upheld a judgement in its favor in a suit with a former Frontier licensee.

The company said the court affirmed the June 19, 1996 decision of the U.S. District Court of Los Angeles in favor of the firm's wholly-owned subsidiary. The decision rejected claims of breach of contract and fraud brought by the former licensee.
At that time, the district court had awarded Frontier unpaid license fees and costs on its counter claim against the former licensee, Frontier said.
